capstone-fde/project-1-hour-1-requiremen.summary: Expected outcome: Application flow and project structure understood; database is reachable.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.body:
- Confirm the customer/admin scope and journey: browse products → product details → cart → checkout → order history.
- Inspect the starter repository; identify React pages, FastAPI routes and PostgreSQL tables.
- Verify the database connection and sample data.

capstone-fde/project-1-hour-2-backend-ap.summary: Expected outcome: Core APIs return real database data and the main business flow is demonstrable.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.body:
- Walk through or implement product/category APIs, cart operations and order APIs.
- Connect endpoints to PostgreSQL and validate request/response behavior.
- Check basic login/role handling if already present in the starter.

capstone-fde/project-1-hour-3-react-ui-a.summary: Expected outcome: Customer flow works across React, FastAPI and PostgreSQL.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.body:
- Connect product listing/details, cart and order screens to FastAPI.
- Demonstrate loading, success, empty and error states.
- Check that cart totals and order data reflect backend responses rather than hard-coded UI data.

capstone-fde/project-1-hour-4-end-to-end.summary: Expected outcome: A working full-stack walkthrough plus verified features and known gaps.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.body:
- Run the customer journey end-to-end; test key admin product/order operations if included.
- Fix one high-priority issue, review environment configuration, and record test results.

capstone-fde/project-2-hour-1-agent-conc.summary: Expected outcome: A simple single-agent flow and its tool boundaries are understood.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.body:
- Choose Shop Assistant use cases: product search, cart questions and order questions.
- Demonstrate a single agent calling a limited set of existing application tools.
- Identify what it handles well and where one agent becomes difficult to control.

capstone-fde/project-2-hour-2-define-mul.summary: Expected outcome: Agent responsibilities, routing rules and permission boundaries are documented.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.body:
- Design the Orchestrator, Product Search Agent, Cart Agent and Order Management Agent.
- Map example questions to specialists and define what each agent may read or change.
- Reuse existing authentication, business rules and database functions.

capstone-fde/project-2-hour-3-build-the-.summary: Expected outcome: A basic multi-agent path routes common requests to the correct specialist.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.body:
- Connect the user request to the Orchestrator, add conditional routing to the relevant specialist, pass only required context, and return the specialist result.
- Test product search, view-cart and order-history questions.

capstone-fde/project-2-hour-4-test-actio.summary: Expected outcome: A single-agent vs multi-agent comparison, with core routing and permission checks tested.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.body:
- Test valid and invalid requests, unclear questions, no-data results, unauthorized cart/order access and repeated action attempts.
- Compare agent results with normal application behavior and record limitations.

capstone-fde/project-3-hour-1-knowledge-.summary: Expected outcome: A small, approved document set is ready for indexing.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.body:
- Select approved product manuals, FAQs or usage guides.
- Demonstrate text extraction, cleaning, chunking, overlap and metadata such as product, document and section.
- Define which questions the assistant is allowed to answer.

capstone-fde/project-3-hour-2-embeddings.summary: Expected outcome: A retrieval step returns relevant chunks with document/source information.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.body:
- Generate embeddings for document chunks, create/load the FAISS index, and map retrieved vectors back to source metadata.
- Run sample queries and inspect whether returned chunks answer them.

capstone-fde/project-3-hour-3-agentic-re.summary: Expected outcome: The RAG assistant answers from approved document content and avoids unsupported claims.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.body:
- Create a simple flow: understand the question → prepare/search query → retrieve → check whether context is sufficient → optionally retry once → generate an answer from retrieved text.
- Return a no-information response when sources do not support an answer.

capstone-fde/project-3-hour-4-api-ui-int.summary: Expected outcome: A working document-question-answering demo with a small evaluation checklist.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.body:
- Expose the RAG flow through a FastAPI endpoint and connect a simple React chat panel.
- Test product specifications, how-to questions, ambiguous questions, no-match questions and prompt-injection attempts.
- Check source references and response behavior.

capstone-fde/project-4-hour-1-integratio.summary: Expected outcome: Integration flow and module boundaries are clear; no duplicate backend or database is introduced.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.body:
- Review the full-stack application and separate Multi-Agent and RAG modules.
- Define one Shop Assistant UI with two explicit modes: “Store Data & Actions” and “Product Manuals.” Confirm both modules reuse the same application, authentication and database.

capstone-fde/project-4-hour-2-integrate-.summary: Expected outcome: Store Data & Actions mode works with existing application data and permitted actions.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.body:
- Connect the chat mode for live store questions and allowed actions.
- Route product/catalog questions, cart operations and order requests through the Orchestrator and specialists.
- Verify user identity and role permissions remain intact.

capstone-fde/project-4-hour-3-integrate-.summary: Expected outcome: Product Manuals mode answers from approved documents and reports when information is not found.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.body:
- Connect Product Manuals mode to the RAG endpoint and FAISS index.
- Return grounded answers and source references.
- Keep manual-based answers separate from live database answers; do not silently mix the two knowledge sources.

capstone-fde/project-4-hour-4-end-to-end.summary: Expected outcome: One integrated application demonstrates full-stack shopping, multi-agent store assistance and Agentic RAG in separate modes.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.body:
- Test both modes, normal shopping flows, authorization boundaries, no-data questions, retrieval failures and service errors.
- Review Langfuse traces/evaluation if configured, clean temporary debug files, and prepare a short demo walkthrough.
